$comment: The committed falsifier for INV-PACK-50, taken straight from EC-PACK-47: 'the generator introduces the bound morpheme 〜枚 through picture-select, whose prompt quotes a standalone word'. `falsifier` is that record — a picture-select quoting a grammar concept the item itself declares. `orphan_quote` is the same class one step out: a lexeme-quoting prompt quoting something that is not in the item's lemma tags at all, which is how a malformed prompt gets shipped when the tag join is wrong rather than the routing. `repair` quotes a real taught lexeme. The NEW WORD clause needs no record here: `shapes.assert_pill_shapes_quote_lexemes` pins the pill-eligible shapes as a strict subset of the lexeme-quoting ones, so a record that passes this check cannot be a grammar concept wearing the pill — and `route()` re-checks that subset relation on every routing decision, so the argument cannot rot.

exercises.prompt:
Which one of these is “〜枚”?
〜枚

Which one of these is “perro”?
perro
